reports.text: [Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/critical-apache-tomcat-flaw/) reported that the Apache Software Foundation disclosed a critical flaw in Apache Tomcat allowing remote attackers to join a trusted server cluster without authentication.

[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/china-linked-hackers-exploit-critical.html) reported that a China-nexus cyber espionage group known as Armory Castle has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a critical VMware vCenter security flaw.

[SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/newly-patched-vmware-vcenter-flaw-exploited-as-zero-day-by-chinese-apt/) reported that Google stated a China-linked espionage group exploited a critical VMware vCenter authentication bypass before Broadcom released a patch.

[BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/vmware-patches-vcenter-zero-day-exploited-in-attacks-since-september/) reported that Broadcom released security updates to fix a critical VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass vulnerability exploited by Chinese-linked hackers since September.

[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/critical-vmware-vcenter-flaw-cvss-98.html) reported that a critical flaw in VMware vCenter lets an attacker with network access bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/vmware-vcenter-authentication-bypass/) reported that Broadcom released fixes for five VMware flaws, including one that lets anyone with network access skip login.

[BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/apache-warns-of-roller-rce-vulnerability-exploited-in-attacks/) reported that Apache has released security updates to address a critical Roller flaw that threat actors are exploiting to gain code execution on vulnerable servers.
[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/critical-apache-roller-rce-flaw-under.html) reported that a critical security flaw in Apache Roller is under active exploitation in the wild.

[Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203419/security/apache-roller-rce-flaw-cve-2026-129448-under-active-attack.html) reported that attackers are exploiting an Apache Roller flaw that allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
[Sophos X-Ops](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/blog/patches-released-for-critical-nginx2root-vulnerabilities) reported that patches have been released for critical NGINX2Root vulnerabilities.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/apache-http-server-rce-exploitation/) reported that Apache’s HTTP/2 module has a critical flaw tracked as CVE-2026-119618 that allows unauthenticated remote code execution.

[SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/apache-patches-critical-http-server-rce-found-by-anthropic-google/) reported that the mod_http2 race condition, CVE-2026-119618, was found by Anthropic and Google.

[BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/apache-http-server-patches-critical-http-2-remote-code-execution-flaw/) reported that a critical vulnerability in the HTTP/2 module of Apache HTTP Server could be exploited by an unauthenticated attacker to obtain remote code execution.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/palo-alto-networks-pan-os-rce-vulnerability/) reported that Palo Alto Networks disclosed a remote code execution vulnerability in PAN-OS software running on Panorama, tracked as CVE-2026-0330.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/apache-patches-critical-http-2-flaw/) reported that Apache fixed a critical bug in its HTTP/2 module, tracked as CVE-2026-119618, that could let a remote attacker run code on a web server.
